full_judgment: 3. Plaint case, in short, is that the suit land measuring about 3.5 decimals out of 8.38 decimals of plot No. 4090 appertaining to SA Khatian No. 807 under Kotwali Police Station in the district of Rangpur was originally owned and possessed by one Hafez Mohammad Hossain, predecessor- in-interest of defendant Nos. 1 to 11. After his death, said defendant Nos. 1 to 11 possessed the suit land. There was a big four-roof tin hut with many rooms therein, which were let out to different tenants. Three shops and adjacent vacant land comprising of 3.5 decimals remained abandoned for many years. In the first part of 1979, the plaintiffs entered into said shops with knowledge of the owner and started business first under the name and style "Capital Papers Mart". In spite of said entry by the plaintiffs, the owner did not take any steps for their eviction nor recognise them as tenants. By such uninterrupted possession of the suit land along with' shops they acquired title.
